Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:10:1.hebrew: ואפילו בקמייתא - גבי מתני', לא בא אחר וקידשה וחזרה בה — קי"ל הילכתא כר' יוחנן, דאתי דיבור ומבטל דיבור:
Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:10:1.english: And even in the first [version] - Regarding our Mishnah, [where] another did not come and betroth her and she retracted, we maintain that the halakha is in accordance with Rabbi Yoḥanan, that a statement comes and nullifies a statement.

Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:11:1.hebrew: מהו שיחזור ויגרש בו - בגט, לאחר שאמר לשליח: "גט שנתתי לך בטל הוא":
Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:11:1.english: What is [the law: can] he return and divorce with it - With the bill of divorce, after he said to the agent: "The bill of divorce that I gave you is nullified."

Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:13:1.hebrew: לעולם - אין בטלין לאחר ל', שהרי ניתן לה זמן לחול בתוך ל', שיהו כולן פנויין מקידושי ראשון:
Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:13:1.english: Forever - [The second man's betrothal] is not nullified after thirty [days], for she was given time for [a betrothal] to take effect within the thirty [days], as all of them were free from the betrothal of the first [man].

Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:13:2.english: And Shmuel says, etc. - Later, Rav Chisda raises an objection to it.

Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:14:1.hebrew: מר ארישא - דמתני', דלא אמר ״מעכשיו״, מתני לה להך פלוגתא; ומשום הכי קשיא ליה למר מאי דקשיא ליה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:14:1.english: The Master [teaches it] with regard to the first clause - Of the Mishnah, where [the man] did not say “from now,” [the Master] teaches this dispute; and because of this, what was difficult for the Master was difficult for him.

Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:15:1.hebrew: מקודשת ואינה מקודשת לעולם - ואפילו לאחר שלשים, עומדת בספק קידושי שניהם, ואסורה לשניהם בלא גט האחד, כדמפרש טעמא לקמן:
Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:15:1.english: [She is] betrothed and not betrothed forever - And even after thirty [days], she remains in doubt regarding the betrothal of both of them, and is forbidden to both of them without a bill of divorce from one [of them], as [the Gemara] explains the reason below:

Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:15:2.hebrew: ושמואל אמר - אינה בספיקא אלא עד שלשים יום, שמא ימות הראשון ולא יגמרו הקדושין, ונמצאו קדושי שני חיילי למפרע:
Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:15:2.english: And Shmuel says - She is in [a state of] doubt only until thirty days, lest the first [man] die and the betrothal not be completed, and the betrothal of the second will turn out to take effect retroactively.

Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:16:1.hebrew: מספקא ליה - האי "לאחר שלשים", אי תנאה הוי: אם לא אחזור בי בתוך ל', יהיו קדושין מעכשיו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:16:1.english: [Rav] is uncertain - Whether this [phrase], "after thirty [days]," is a condition: "If I do not retract within thirty [days], the betrothal shall take effect from now."

Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:16:2.hebrew: אי חזרה הוי - ממאי דקאמר "מעכשיו", וקאמר: איני אומר "מעכשיו", אלא "התקדשי לי לאחר ל'". הילכך, לעולם היא בספיקא: דאי הוי תנאה — קידושי ראשון חיילי, קידושי שני לא חיילי; ואם חזרה הוי — קידושי שני חיילי, קידושי ראשון לא חיילי:
Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:16:2.english: Or is it a retraction - [Meaning, a retraction] from what he said, "From now," and he is saying: "I am not saying 'from now,' but rather, 'Be betrothed to me after thirty [days]'." Therefore, she is forever in [a state of] uncertainty: for if it was a condition, the betrothal of the first [man] takes effect [and] the betrothal of the second does not take effect; and if it is a retraction, the betrothal of the second takes effect [and] the betrothal of the first does not take effect.

Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:16:3.hebrew: לשמואל פשיטא ליה דתנאה הוי - הילכך, כל ל' יום הוו קידושין תלוין, שמא יחזור בו; מל' ואילך — גמרו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:16:3.english: To Shmuel, it is obvious that it was a condition - Therefore, throughout the thirty days, the betrothal remains in suspense, lest he retract; from thirty [days] onward, [the betrothal] is finalized.

Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:17:1.hebrew: גט ואינו גט - מספקא ליה האי "ולאחר מיתה": אי הוי תנאה — "מהיום יהיה גט אם אמות", ולכשימות נמצא גט למפרע מאותו יום; אי חזרה הוי — וחזר בו מ"מהיום", ואמר: "זה גיטך לאחר מיתה", ולא אמר כלום — דאין גט לאחר מיתה, דכיון דמית, היכי מגרש:
Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:17:1.english: [It is] a bill of divorce and not a bill of divorce - He [the Tanna] is in doubt regarding this [phrase], "and after death": whether it is a condition — [meaning,] "It shall be a bill of divorce from today if I die," and when he dies, it turns out to be a bill of divorce retroactively from that day; or whether it is a retraction — and he retracted [his words,] "from today," and said, "This is your bill of divorce after death," and [thus] he has said nothing, for there is no bill of divorce after death, since once he has died, how can he divorce [her]?

Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:17:2.english: [A document] like this is a bill of divorce - For it is a condition.

Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:18:1.hebrew: התם - הוא דאיכא לספוקי ולמימר חזרה הוי, משום דלרחוקה אתי, וקשה בעיניו לרחקה ולגרשה, ולהכי הדר ביה ממעכשיו. אבל הכא, דלקרובה קאמר, כל מה דמצי לקרובה מקרב לה, וכי אמר לאחר שלשים — לא הדר ביה ממעכשיו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:18:1.english: There - It is [only] there that there is [room] to be in doubt and say that it is a retraction, because he comes to distance her, and it is hard for him to distance her and divorce her, and therefore he retracted from "from now." But here, where he speaks to draw her near, as much as he can draw her near he draws her near; and when he said "after thirty [days]," he did not retract from "from now."

Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:19:1.hebrew: התם - הוא דאמר תנאה הוא ולא חזרה, דאדם יודע דאין גט לאחר מיתה, ומידי דכדי לא עביד איניש דאמר:
Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:19:1.english: There - It is [only there] that he said [that] it is a condition and not a retraction, as a person knows that there is no bill of divorce after death, and a person does not do something in vain, that he would say [so].

Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:19:2.hebrew: אבל הכא - דיש קדושין לאחר ל' יום, אם לא קדשה אחר בנתיים, אימא: דילמא הוי חזרה, דלא רצה לקדשה מעכשיו, שמא דעתו על אחרת וימלך בתוך שלשים יום — קמשמע לן:
Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:19:2.english: But here - Where betrothal after thirty days is [effective] if another [man] did not betroth her in the interim, I would say: Perhaps it is a retraction, for he did not want to betroth her from now, lest his mind [be set] on another [woman] and he reconsider within the thirty days — [therefore,] it teaches us [otherwise].

Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:1:1.hebrew: מעשה מוציא מיד מעשה - התחיל לשוף, ביטל מהם תורת גמר מלאכה לשם כלי — בין שירד להו ע"י מעשה, שהחליקן וגילה דעתו שאין מחוסרין עוד תיקון, בין שירד להו ע"י מחשבה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:1:1.english: An action negates [the status created by] an action - [If] he began to scrape [them], he has nullified from them the status of completion of work as a vessel — whether [this status] descended upon them through an action, in that he smoothed them and revealed his intention that they lack no further finishing, or whether it descended upon them through thought.

Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:1:2.hebrew: מחשבה אינה מוציאה - חישב עליהן לשוף, לשבץ, אחר שחישב עליהן שלא לשוף, שלא לשבץ — אין יוצאין מידי מחשבתן הראשונה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:1:2.english: Thought does not negate - [If] he intended concerning them to smooth [or] to checker [them], after he had intended concerning them not to smooth [and] not to checker [them] — they do not leave [the status imparted by] their initial thought.

Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:20:1.hebrew: ולטעמיה דרב - דמספקא ליה בחזרה ותנאה: בא אחד ואמר "מעכשיו ולאחר שלשים", ובא אחר ואמר "מעכשיו ולאחר עשרים" — שכלו של שני בתוך של ראשון; ואם דראשון חזרה — הוו להו דשני קידושין, דהא ראשון הדר ביה ממעכשיו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:20:1.english: And according to the reasoning of Rav - For he is uncertain whether [it is a] retraction or a condition: [If] one came and said, "From now and after thirty [days]," and another came and said, "From now and after twenty [days]" — so that [the period] of the second concludes within [that] of the first; and if [the statement] of the first was a retraction, the [betrothal] of the second is a [valid] betrothal, for the first retracted from "from now."

Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:2:1.hebrew: דכי מעשה דמיא - דרחמנא קרייה מעשה, דכתיב: "כי יתן", והיינו בידים; ואע"ג דמחשבה בעלמא הוא — דאפילו נפלו ממילא וניחא ליה הוי הכשר — ומיקרי "כי יותן":
Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:2:1.english: As it is considered like action - For the Merciful One called it an action, as it is written: “If [one] puts,” which means by [human] hands; and even though it is mere thought — for even if [water] fell on its own and it is pleasing to him, it constitutes preparation [for ritual impurity] — and it is read: “If it is placed.”

Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:4:1.english: This teaching - Of Rabbi Yochanan and Reish Lakish.

Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:4:2.hebrew: וכן היא שנתנה כו' - משנה היא לקמן בפ' בתרא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:4:2.english: And similarly, she who gave, etc. - It is a Mishnah later on, in the final chapter.

Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:5:1.hebrew: וחזרה בה - בין בפני שליח, בין שלא בפניו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:5:1.english: And retracted - Whether in the presence of the agent or not in his presence.

Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:5:2.english: She cannot retract - And later we raise an objection to him from that [mishnah] of 'One who sends a bill of divorce'.

Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:7:1.hebrew: מחשבה אינה מוציאה - חישב עליהן לשוף, לשבץ, אחר שחישב עליהן שלא לשוף, שלא לשבץ — אין יוצאין מידי מחשבתן הראשונה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 59b:7:1.english: Thought does not negate - [If] he intended regarding them to smooth [or] to inlay [them], after he [already] intended regarding them not to smooth [and] not to inlay [them] — they do not emerge from [the status created by] their first thought:

Tosafot on Kiddushin 59b:12:1.hebrew: מתורת גט לא בטליה - פי': דמסתמא אינו מתכוין לבטל אלא השליח. ולפי זה, אם אמר בפירוש: "אני מבטל הגט עצמו" — שהוא בטול, ופסול לגרש בו. ובפרק השולח (גיטין דף לב:) גריס: "גיטא גופיה מי קא בטל?", משמע שאין הגט מתבטל; וצריך לפרש: אתה סבור שהגט יכול ליפסל בביטול? ולא היא, דהרי הוא כמו מעות שאינן מתבטלות, דמאחר דהגט כתוב כהלכתו אינו יכול לבטלו, ואם ירצה יחזור ויגרש בו:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 59b:12:1.english: "He has not nullified it from its status as a bill of divorce" - Explanation: For presumably he only intends to nullify the agent. And according to this, if he said explicitly, "I nullify the bill of divorce itself," it is nullified and invalid to divorce with it. But in the chapter [entitled] Hasholeiach (Gittin 32b), [the text] reads: "Is the bill of divorce itself nullified?" which implies that the bill of divorce does not become nullified. And [thus] one must explain: Do you think that the bill of divorce can become disqualified through nullification? But that is not so, for it is like money, which cannot be nullified; since the bill of divorce was written in accordance with its halakhah, he cannot nullify it, and if he wishes, he may return and divorce with it.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 59b:1:1.hebrew: מיד מחשבה מיהא תפיק - תימה, ליפרוך נמי גבי תרומה לעיל לר"י: דקאמר "אם עד שלא תרם ביטל — אין תרומתו תרומה", אבל אם משתרם ביטל — תרומתו תרומה, ואפילו תרם השליח במחשבה, דהא תרומה ניטלת באומד ומחשבה; אלמא: לא אתי דיבור ומבטל דיבור! וי"ל: דמחשבה דתרומה היה יודע דכמעשה דמי, דכתיב (במדבר י״ח:כ״ז): "ונחשב לכם", והוי כאילו תרם בידים, ואפילו מעשה אינו מוציא — אפילו תרם אח"כ כריו אחר מחשבת השליח. אבל גבי טומאה, אין המחשבה מטמאתו, אבל מביאתו לידי תורת קבלת טומאה; ואותה הבאה יכולה להתבטל, דהכל מודים דע"י המעשה מתבטלת — א"כ, תתבטל על ידי מחשבה:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 59b:1:1.english: But it should at least offset thought - [This is] puzzling: let him also object above regarding teruma to Rabbi Yoḥanan! As it says: "If before he separated [teruma] he canceled [the agency], his teruma is not teruma" — but if he canceled after he separated, his teruma is teruma, and even if the agent separated [it] in thought, as teruma is taken by estimation and thought; evidently, a statement does not come and nullify a statement! And one can say: regarding the thought of teruma, he [Reish Lakish] knew that it is considered like an action, as it is written (Numbers 18:27): "And it shall be reckoned to you," and it is as though he separated [it] with [his own] hands, and even an action does not negate [it] — even if he subsequently separated [teruma from] his grain heap after the thought of the agent. However, with regard to ritual impurity, thought does not render it impure, but [merely] brings it into the rule of susceptibility to ritual impurity; and that bringing [into susceptibility] can be nullified, as all agree that by means of an action it is nullified — if so, let it be nullified by means of thought.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 59b:5:1.hebrew: לא קידשה עצמה וחזרה בה מהו - נראה לפרש: "וחזרה בה" — בלא אמירתה לשליח; דאי אמרה לשליח: "אין רצוני שתקדשני", פשיטא דאינה מקודשת, דאטו משום דאמרה לו: "תיהוי לי שליח לקדשני", לא מצי' חוזרת?:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 59b:5:1.english: "[If] she did not betroth herself and retracted, what is the halakha?" - It appears [correct] to explain: "And retracted" [means] without telling the agent; for if she said to the agent, "It is not my wish that you betroth me," it is obvious that she is not betrothed, for is it [conceivable that just] because she said to him, "Be my agent to betroth me," she cannot retract?!

Tosafot on Kiddushin 59b:6:1.hebrew: אם ביטל עד שלא תרם כו' - הכא לא משני כדלעיל: "שאני נתינת מעות ליד האשה דכמעשה דמי" — היינו משום דהכא ליכא נתינת מעות, אלא דיבור לבד:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 59b:6:1.english: "If he canceled before he separated [teruma], etc." - The reason [the Gemara] here does not answer as [it did] above — "Giving money into the woman's hand is different, as it is considered like an action" — is because here there is no giving of money, but only speech.
